gloss: just barely; at the last moment; on the edge

definitions.gloss: just barely; at the last moment
definitions.explanation: Describes doing something with no time or margin to spare, just making it.

definitions.gloss: at the limit; to the edge
definitions.explanation: Describes being at the very limit of something, with no room for error.

examples.japanese: ぎりぎり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}った→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧。
examples.english: I just barely made it on time for the train.

examples.japanese: ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧ぎりぎり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}→提出：03542_teishutsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I submitted it right at the deadline.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ぎりぎり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I just barely passed the exam.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぎりぎり⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The budget is at its limit.

examples.japanese: ⟦ガソリン→ガソリン：01346_gasorin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぎりぎり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The gas is almost empty and I'm worried.

examples.japanese: ⟦スーツケース→スーツケース：01781_suutsukeesu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ぎりぎり⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{詰|つ}めた→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{閉|し}める→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I packed the suitcase to the brim, so it was hard to close.

notes:
ぎりぎり is a mimetic word (⟦{擬態語|ぎたいご}→擬態語：22468_gitaigo⟧) that expresses having almost no margin — just barely enough time, space, money, or capacity.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ぎりぎり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}う→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧: to just barely make it in time
- ぎりぎり⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: until the very last moment
- ぎりぎり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: at the limit, barely managing
- ぎりぎり⟦セーフ→セーフ：09479_seefu⟧: just barely safe/OK (casual)
- ぎりぎり⟦アウト→アウト：00007_auto⟧: just barely too late/out (casual)

USAGE:
Can function as an adverb (ぎりぎり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧), a na-adjective (⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぎりぎり⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧), or a noun modifier (ぎりぎり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ = barely getting by). Often implies stress, urgency, or cutting it close.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ぎりぎり: barely, at the limit (tight margin)
- ⟦かろうじて→辛うじて：05721_karoujite⟧: barely, narrowly (more formal/literary)
- ⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧: finally, with difficulty
